notablePrerequisites: You control creatures that can tap to produce at least {3}.
description:
Cast Skilled Animator by paying {2}{U}.
Skilled Animator enters the battlefield, targeting Isochron Scepter, causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate creatures you control by tapping those, adding {3}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 3.
